INTER-OFFICE CORRESPONDENCE
120 PARK AVENUE, NEW YORK, NY 10017-5592

PHILIP MORRIS USA

TO: Distribution

DATE: May 17, 1993

FROM: Marketing Information & Analysis/ Barbara Weinstein

SUBJECT: McLane Weekly Report: Week Ending 4/30/93

All data comparisons reflect current four weeks vs four weeks ago, unless specified.

PHILIP MORRIS

- Within C-stores, PM recorded the largest share gain among the manufacturers of +5.0 share points to 37.5 share, as Marlboro 5 for 3 shipments continued.

• Marlboro volume was +31% above the previous four weeks with 37% of stores receiving 5 for 3 product, representing 12% of Marlboro's volume.

- Shipments of 5 for 3 fell to 5% of stores for the current week from last week's peak in 23% of stores.

- Thirteen of the C-store chains have received the promotion to date, except Thrifty, Coastal Mart and Emro, where competitive Deep Discounts have a strong presence. Emro is scheduled to receive the promotion the week of May 17.

DISCOUNT CATEGORY

- The Discount category lost more share in C-stores than in Mass Merchandisers due to fewer re-orders of RJR Deep Discount products.

- The Discount segment declined -6.1 share points to 45.2 share in C-stores as RJR's Deep Discount products lost -5.1 share points to 22.8 for the current four weeks. The majority of the loss was by Jacks, a private label sold in Diamond Shamrock stores where only 30% of the stores have reordered the product in the past seven weeks after shipments to all stores in the chain. In contrast, Sundance private label in Loaf-N-Jug rose to 16% share in the current week from a depressed 4-5% share level, and the number of cartons per store almost doubled.

- Basic, at 2.6 share in C-stores was -0.2 points below the prior four weeks, and -2.7% lower in volume. TRMI-Texaco stores began receiving product during the latest four weeks.

- In Wal-Mart, Discount shares lost -2.4 points to 38.9. PM's Basic declined as excess inventory is preventing McLane from shipping product with the 75¢/ctm allowance to Sam's Wholesale Clubs. RJR's Monarch and Best Value also fell, despite product with allowance in these stores.

COMPETITIVE

- RJR lost -4.6 share points to 39.8 share in C-stores, as high Deep Discount inventories are sold at retail.

2045883519

- RJR's Premium business (13.9) increased slightly (+0.3) vs four weeks ago due to Camel Special Lights sell-in. Introductory 2 for 1 product represented 63% of the brand's volume. Its weekly share remained at 1.1.

- Liggett's one week share of 32.8 rose +10.5 share points vs week ago in the 320 store Emro chain due to large shipments of their Premium Brands Chesterfield, Eve and Lark, to almost the entire chain. Their Deep Discount franchise, dominant in this chain, remained stable at 21.1 share.

[SIGNATURE] Bullow
